_comment: The 'What's new' feed for Needs Atlas. Add a new object to the top of the list for each change. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), tag (Feature | Data | Accuracy | Access | Fix | Launch), title, summary. Newest entries are shown first automatically.

updates.title: Economic hardship (ALICE) & provider access added
updates.summary: Two long-pending sources are now wired in: United For ALICE household hardship rates (an 'ALICE households' tile) and County Health Rankings provider-to-population ratios (a new Provider access panel), both compared with New Jersey and added to the county assessments.

updates.title: FAQ page added
updates.summary: A plain-English FAQ and a full at-a-glance list of everything the tool does — find it in the Menu.

updates.title: Funding matches — grant opportunities, ranked
updates.summary: A new Funding matches view pulls open federal opportunities from Grants.gov and ranks them for each county by fit to its documented needs, with the evidence to make the case. Find it in the Menu.

updates.title: Statewide standing added
updates.summary: The community-health section now shows where each county ranks among all 21 New Jersey counties, so applications can cite statewide standing rather than only a seven-county comparison.

updates.title: Chronic disease & health burden added
updates.summary: Community health measures from the CDC's PLACES project — diabetes, obesity, high blood pressure, heart disease, mental distress, and health-related social needs like transportation and housing — now appear on the dashboard (county vs. New Jersey) and in the downloadable county assessments.

updates.title: “What's new” feed launched
updates.summary: This page — a running, dated log of changes to Needs Atlas so you can see how the tool evolves over time.

updates.title: Account requests & approval (rolling out)
updates.summary: People can request an account from the sign-in screen; access is granted by the administrator, with a bot check on the request form. Turns on once final setup is complete.

updates.title: Food insecurity added
updates.summary: County food-insecurity and child food-insecurity rates from Feeding America's Map the Meal Gap (2024) now appear on the dashboard and in the downloadable assessments.

updates.title: SNAP participation added
updates.summary: Household SNAP/food-stamp receipt (Census table B22003) is now one of the tract need indicators and a dashboard figure.

updates.title: Interactive tract map
updates.summary: All 682 census tracts across the seven counties, shaded by need, with the selected county outlined. Click any tract for its numbers.

updates.title: Dashboard and documents reconciled
updates.summary: County headline figures now use the Census Bureau's published QuickFacts values, so the dashboard and the Word assessments always show the same number.

updates.title: About page & source links
updates.summary: A plain-English explanation of the method, checks and balances, and direct links to every Census table behind the numbers so anyone can verify them.
